nodes.label: Primary Brand Logo Mockup (Website Context)
nodes.description: A JPEG screenshot/mockup showing the Chicken Time logo displayed large above a browser window rendering the Chicken Time website. The logo is the clean flat-design version: circular badge shape with deep crimson red background, gold/yellow concentric ring border, white bold uppercase text 'CHICKEN' arced at top and 'TIME' arced at bottom, a central analog clock face (white dial, black numerals 1-12, black hour/minute hands, red second hand), and a cartoon white rooster mascot wearing a white chef's hat positioned to the right. A black ribbon banner beneath reads 'PIRI PIRI & PERFECTION' in gold serif text. Background has subtle feather watermark pattern. Also shows the logo small in the browser tab and navbar.
